# Security Policy

## Reporting Security Issues

The RouteWarden team takes the security of our software and users seriously. If you have discovered or suspect a security vulnerability in any RouteWarden project, please report it to us responsibly.

### How to Report

Please **do not** open public GitHub issues or discussions for undisclosed security vulnerabilities.

Instead:
1. Submit a private vulnerability report via **GitHub Security Advisories** on the relevant repository (e.g. [`routewarden/traefik-warden/security/advisories/new`](https://github.com/routewarden/traefik-warden/security/advisories/new)).
2. Or contact the maintainers directly via email if private advisory reporting is unavailable.

### What to Include in Your Report

To help us triage and resolve the issue quickly, please provide:
- A description of the vulnerability and potential impact.
- Step-by-step reproduction instructions or a minimal proof of concept (PoC).
- Affected version(s) or commit hashes.
- Any suggested fixes or mitigations, if known.

### Disclosure Policy

- We will acknowledge receipt of your vulnerability report within 48 hours.
- We will provide a timeline for triage and resolution.
- We will coordinate a responsible disclosure timeline once a patch is verified and released.
